title: “Kung comment lang ang breakthrough… bakit hindi lahat mayaman?”
paragraphs: “Kung comment lang ang breakthrough… bakit hindi lahat mayaman?”

👉 “Comment AMEN and receive financial breakthrough in 24 hours.”
👉 “Type YES if you claim this blessing.”
I need to say this with love…

God is not an algorithm.
Hindi Siya na-trigger ng comments.
Hindi Siya na-manipulate ng shares.

The Bible never taught:
“Comment and receive.”

It taught:
“Seek first the Kingdom.” (Matthew 6:33)
“Sow in obedience.” (2 Corinthians 9:7)
“Trust the Lord.” (Proverbs 3:5)

Financial breakthrough is not unlocked by typing AMEN.
It is built through wisdom, stewardship, prayer, and obedience.

Some posts are not prophetic.
They are engineered for engagement.

Fear sells.
Hope manipulates.
But truth sets free.

Kung breakthrough ay nasa comment section lang,
eh di sana lahat tayo milyonaryo.
Let’s grow deeper than viral Christianity.
